purpose: Teach: 右足/ピル/人妻/男児/牙/疾走/歓喜/先導

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、右足利き競走選手の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you worked on research about right-footedness in competitive athletes for your paper, didn't you?
lines.style: Steady, observant tone. Light question at the end—inviting confirmation without pressure. Warm attentiveness, the kind a good teacher gives before gently presenting something unexpected.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、低用量ピル普及率の研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I worked on research about the prevalence of low-dose contraceptives for my paper.
lines.style: Careful, precise answer. Slight pause before the topic—not evasive, just gathering words. Quiet and direct, speaking as though he's thought about how to explain this clearly.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、人妻文学の社会学を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you worked on the sociology of literature about married women for your paper, didn't you?
lines.style: Thoughtful, measured delivery. Slight tilt of curiosity—she's noticing something. Pause before the topic, as if she's choosing her words with care. Genuinely engaged, not testing.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、男児出生率の地域差を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I worked on research about regional differences in male birth rates for my paper.
lines.style: Steady response. No hesitation—he's learned to answer these straightforwardly. Quiet conviction in his words, like he's made peace with the topics he chooses.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 哺乳類の牙進化を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You worked on the evolution of fangs in mammals for your paper, didn't you?
lines.style: Direct, engaged question—she's leaning into this now. Quicker pace, slight brightness in tone. She's connecting something, and there's a note of careful interest in how she frames it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、競馬の疾走フォーム研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I worked on research about stride mechanics in racehorses for my paper.
lines.style: Calm, unflinching answer. He delivers it the same way as before—not defensive, just matter-of-fact. The slight tiredness of having explained these choices repeatedly.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、宗教的歓喜の心理学を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you worked on the psychology of religious joy for your paper, didn't you?
lines.style: Quieter now. Genuine warmth underneath. She's moving slower, giving him space. This question carries something different—not testing anymore, but really listening.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、先導役のリーダーシップ論を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I worked on research about leadership in supporting roles for my paper.
lines.style: Final answer, delivered with quiet resolution. He's said these words many times now. Slight settling at the end—the relief of having gotten through it all, still standing.
